steps.text: Whisk together the vinegar, parsley, dill, garlic, sugar, and salt in a bowl; add the cucumber and stir to coat. Cover and chill in refrigerator 4 to 8 hours. Stir well before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Cucumber Salad
raw_recipe.description: This is a perfect side dish for your summer barbecue or any Mediterranean or Middle Eastern dish. You can also substitute 2 large tomatoes for the cucumber for a delicious tomato salad.
raw_recipe.name: Easy Cucumber Salad

recipeInstructions.text: Whisk together the vinegar, parsley, dill, garlic, sugar, and salt in a bowl; add the cucumber and stir to coat. Cover and chill in refrigerator 4 to 8 hours. Stir well before serving.

review.reviewBody: Very good cucumber salad - just what I needed to as a side dish for grilled chicken. I used white wine vinegar because it's a bit milder. I also used two cucumbers that I thinly sliced and didn't peel. Very simple and very good.

For 2 cucumbers I substituted 1 tsp dried dill, 1 tsp garlic powder and dropped the parsley (since I didn't have any). Didn't have time to chill it 4 hrs, but it was amazing and delicious after 30m. There were no leftovers!

I used some some of the other's comments, I am just repeating the other person so I can find it when I make this again in a couple of days. Loved it. 

"For 2 cucumbers I substituted 1 tsp dried dill, 1 tsp garlic powder and dropped the parsley (since I didn't have any). Didn't have time to chill it 4 hrs, but it was amazing and delicious after 30m. There were no leftovers!"

I initially made it exactly as listed - the only true way to review a new recipe. The amount of garlic and herbs overpowers the cucumbers instead of enhancing their flavor like they should. I cut back the dill to 3/4 tsp, the parsley to 1 tsp, the minced garlic to 1/4 tsp, and added 2 tbsp chopped white onion. This allowed the cuke flavor to really blossom. Chilling at least 2 hours so cukes are crisp - very refreshing - a perfect summer side dish.
I replaced white vinegar with rice wine vinegar, the garlic with crushed ginger & the herbs with thin slivers of the green of green onions & kept sugar & salt the same. Turned out really delish!
This is wonderful! I also added tomato & onion to mine & it tasted great. Very quick to make & it's still good even if you don't let it sit in the fridge for as long as the recipe calls for.

this was very good, but i thought the dressing could use some oil so i added a tablespoon of oil, i also added 1/2 cup diced tomato, and a couple thin onion slices, the dressing is something i will use again, it would be great on other salads as well, i will definately make this again, thank you, gotta go make more!!!

I only added 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar and only had dried parsley but this gets watery and all the fresh dill ends up on the bottom instead of on the cucumbers. I also added some red onion and cut up grape tomatoes. I still like it but maybe more vinegar will give it more flavor??

What do you know, a salad that has no lettuce! This is an easy, summery, and light salad, with just enough interest and crunch to sit beside a sandwich for lunch, or barbecue chicken or grilled fish, for dinner. I followed the recipe exactly, except for keeping the peeling on my cukes for fiber and extra color. I loved the use of fresh herbs, too!

So easy to put together and the flavors are great! I made this recipe at lunch and it was ready to eat by dinnertime. I didn't have fresh herbs on hand, but the dried dill and parsley came back to life while marinating. The garlic isn't too overpowering and the sugar helps round out the tang of the vinegar. I'll definitely be making again!

Enjoyed!

After reading the reviews, I halved the vinegar, and also used less dill. I added feta cheese and a little red onion (If you're gonna add red onions, I suggest covering them in cold water and squeezing them; rinse and repeat a few times. It makes them more mild - otherwise they can be really overpowering.)
Way too strong taste
Very tasty.. making it again tonight!! Thank you🙂
It was light and refreshing
This is so good. Great around a pool or just a great salad to any dish. I added tomatoes because my friend made it that way and it was the best !
Brilliant! No changes necessary, though I added a hint of lemon. Even after only 45 mins in the fridge it's ready! This is a recipe for the gods!
Chose to do the modifications of adding tomato, and substituted seasoned rice vinegar. Really light and delicious!
I also added basil - but it was what I’d hoped it’d be. Bright. Crisp. Cool. Perfect for a warm spring or summer day. Loved it. The fact that it was also super easy was a bonus!!! Lots of flavor.
I made no changes. It was ok but a wee bit strong.

Luckily I halved all the ingredients at first because I didn’t know how large 1 seedless cucumber should be. Please see about measuring a chopped cucumber and use that measurement. I used a large English cucumber, seeded and half the dressing seemed like enough.
